proposed_widenings.name: grant_reaction_move
proposed_widenings.justification: The surrounded-creature mechanic requires granting the target permission to use their Reaction to move up to their Speed to escape enclosure. No existing EffectAtom covers (a) consuming the target's Reaction resource and (b) granting movement up to the target's Speed. force_move is involuntary (caster-driven); this is player-optional and Reaction-costed. A new atom is needed to represent 'target may use their Reaction to move up to their Speed' as the onSuccess result of the save_gate.
proposed_widenings.evidence: On a success, it can use its Reaction to move up to its Speed so that it is no longer enclosed by the wall.

notes: Core mechanics encode cleanly: create_object (AC 15, 30 HP/inch, poison+psychic immunity) + force_move push for creatures in the wall's path + concentration with permanentIfMaintainedFull. The surrounded-creature save_gate is omitted because the onSuccess result ('use Reaction to move up to Speed') has no matching EffectAtom; using none for onSuccess would be dishonest. The wall's arbitrary geometry is approximated as a line 100×10 ft (10 panels of 10×10 ft default configuration).
